title: Fixed Yoked Bell and Rope Wheel Frame
description: One newly authored complete static timber bell frame. Two grounded runners and braced bearing posts carry a horizontal axle and full timber yoke over one hollow flared bronze bell with a closed crown, thick continuous wall and genuinely open lower mouth. Two crown straps connect the bell to the yoke; a whole internal clapper is fixed at the crown. A large side wheel has a full rim, six spokes, a bored hub and a short continuous descending rope. This is a complete axle-yoke-wheel suspension layout, not an enlarged handled handbell or a tubular percussion rack with changed tube count. Three opaque PBR materials; metres, Z up, horizontally centred whole ground datum. One static model, zero scenes; no swing rig, ringing, tuning, torque, rope action, load capacity, assembly engineering, fabrication or safety claims.
